principle: One VibeCart commerce backend; provider adapters contain no pricing, checkout, payment, cart, or order-state implementation.

codex.setup: Add VibeCart as a remote MCP server in Codex and keep tool approvals enabled for commerce actions.

chatgpt.setup: Use ChatGPT's current custom MCP app/developer flow on an eligible plan and register the VibeCart remote MCP URL.

claude_code.command: claude mcp add --transport http vibecart https://vibecart.vercel.app/mcp

gemini_interactions.constraint: Remote MCP requires Streamable HTTP. Keep the server name hyphen-free.

cursor.setup: Add a remote Streamable HTTP MCP server in Cursor's MCP settings.

ucpAwareClients.requirement: Use only from a UCP-aware platform that supplies meta.ucp-agent.profile and negotiates the advertised capability.
